remarks: If your ideal home is one where you can get to everything in minutes but still come back to a quiet spot that feels like home, this Mid-City Stamford townhome delivers. With a little over 2,000 sq ft of finished space, the layout is bright, open, and easy to live in. The main level features a comfortable living room with sliders to a private balcony, a dining area with room to host, and a kitchen with two sinks, granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and an open flow to the dining room. Upstairs, the primary suite spans the full width of the home with two closets and a private bath, plus two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. The walk-out lower level adds real flexibility with a large rec room, two bonus rooms, and a full bath, perfect for an office, guest space, gym, or playroom. The community handles snow removal, landscaping, and offers an in-ground pool. Two assigned parking spaces included. All of this in a location close to shops, dining, parks, Metro North, I-95, and the Merritt, making everyday life simple and convenient with plenty of room to grow.
